endorsements.quote: Robustness: Stress testing of model performance under varying conditions, including data perturbations, missing values, and edge cases [6].
Conduct quarterly Ethical Assessment audits using updated bias detection libraries
Performance Monitoring Infrastructure: Assessment of systems in place to continuously monitor model performance in production environments [5][7].
Fairness and Bias: Evaluation of model performance across demographic subgroups, with emphasis on identifying and mitigating disparate impact [8].

unlisted_practices: Score healthcare ML models with a quantitative multidimensional framework covering technical, clinical, operational, ethical, and longitudinal dimensions.
Require a minimum longitudinal monitoring score above 4.0/5 for chronic disease prediction models.
Assign at least 30% weight to Clinical Translation when evaluating emergency care models.

screen.reason: The paper introduces a framework (MEPALS) providing recommendations and guidelines for evaluating machine learning models across clinical, ethical, and operational dimensions.
